stage2.category_policy: Only visually confirmed powered pallet trucks/stackers/reach trucks are included in current forklift vehicle class. Manual pallet jacks and uncertain/blurred samples excluded. Other source annotations are unchanged.
stage2.training: Warm start phase1 epoch3; 2 epochs/640/AdamW .0001/freeze10/seed20261016; 875 unique images, 958 sampling draws
stage2.challenge_limitation: All 100 challenge observations are development cases from presentation video5, which was already represented in original training and reviewed CVAT crops. Later timestamps are not independent test data.
stage2.decision: Rejected: 44/90 or 42/90 pedestrian false vehicle observations vs fair baseline37/90, despite preserving10/10 reviewed vehicles.

stage3.test_limitations: Repeatedly inspected fixed 61-image test and training-exposed presentation5 challenge; neither proves independent-site generalization.

vehicle_box_regression.visual_review: Candidate envelope includes adjacent worker and stockpile. Larger box shifts bottom-centre distance proxy; vehicle-presence retention alone is insufficient for proximity selection.

video1.additional_five_observations_visually_ch: Actual loaded forklift including truck behind foreground worker; not treated as five independent vehicles.

stage3.full_video5_status: Stopped before completion after confirmed geometry regression; no whole-video performance claim, no promotion.

final_selection.reason: Candidate vehicle-presence improvements do not offset observed box-geometry regression in distance-critical scene. Other candidates lose true vehicles or increase pedestrian false positives. No threshold tuning or new time/region suppression used.

training.planned_schedule: Three epochs freeze10 at1280, then one low-rate full-feature epoch on the same1000 unique images; replacing the originally planned fourth frozen epoch after audited vehicle misses.

last_1000_training.baseline_roofless_limit: Nine existing LOCO subset4 validation targets, same confidence .25 and IoU .5; small validation stratum, not independent test accuracy.

checkpoint_decisions.epoch1: Not selected: 14/90 pedestrian false vehicle observations, but only5/10 audited vehicle locations retained under identical matching. Inspect actual boxes before final classification; other training epochs still running.
checkpoint_decisions.epoch3: Not selected:18/90 pedestrian false vehicle observations,5/10 audited vehicle locations retained. Actual vehicle misses remain.

last_1000_training.experimental_gate_decision: Not applied: primary proposal gate .12 and removal of extra geometric-mean rejection each recovered only one additional audited vehicle. No scores fabricated; all production thresholds unchanged.

temporal_window_validation.method: Same actual observed people and source pixels; for each vehicle target, process the preceding50 source frames at the existing5-frame sample interval. Maintain normal1-second search history; reset only between disconnected windows. Never reuse historical boxes as detections.

last_1000_training.evaluation_count_unit: Manually reviewed repeated object observations at specified timestamps; not unique vehicles/people or independent-site accuracy.
last_1000_training.training_chain: 3 completed frozen epochs at1280 plus1 full-feature epoch on the same1000 unique training images. Partial fourth frozen updates discarded; all four retained checkpoints evaluated. No training beyond this chain.

final_selection.reason: New models improve some image metrics and9-target powered-vehicle validation, but all four regress in same-condition real-source sequential target windows: baseline10/10 versus6,7,7,6 retained observations. Actual missed source frames were visually checked.

limits.reason_for_skipping_full_render: All candidates rejected on safety-critical video5 sequential vehicle misses before promotion; existing model and all five current review hashes are preserved.

selection_proof.left: existing primary+support, same sequential source windows
selection_proof.right: last1000-image candidate+same support, same sequential source windows

final_five_video_acceptance.selection: PPE balanced800 epoch1 plus existing forklift690 primary/support; weights unchanged
final_five_video_acceptance.method: Videos 1/3/4/5 full-source decode and cached current observations replay; video2 fresh complete inference. Not a fresh detector inference of all five videos. Visual review of 15 representative rendered frames plus whole sampled-log invariant checks.
final_five_video_acceptance.fixed: Dashboard camera labels still used legacy seven-video numbering; current demo-video1/3/5 now mapped correctly. Legacy nonconflicting IDs explicitly marked past.
limits: Tiny or occluded heads remain unknown
